original_card.question: Is there a genuinely unsearched, explicitly bounded improvement to the selected packing?
methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live PR overlap first, price both suppliers and distinguish a search best from an optimum. Report the word's packing cap from ceiling.ceiling() and the fraction of it realized; label packing gains as such.

first_step.inspect: Locate the selected packing source in the review and check live PRs for the same residual problem.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Define an unclaimed canonical domain and a favorable bound before starting a new search.
original_card.bottleneck_link: An actual paid-profile gain can improve the frontier up to the other supplier cap.
allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.

existing_checks.scope: Packing-independent ceiling for the selected paid profile under the one-unpaid-coordinate coverage and halving guard.
existing_checks.remaining: A changed word or model requires new pricing; a local packing search must name uncovered scope.

actual_scope: PR2979's unchanged words (the latest candidate, not the selected record): a literal integral allocation that attains their fixed-capacity packing cap. T740 = ten lockstep copies of PR2979's literal T74 fill (PR2969's lift convention) plus 332 explicit whole-role relocations (chains of same-width exchanges) that put the total pattern mix on an integral point of the optimal face.
scope_change_reason: The card targets the selected record's packing. The selected word's packing ceiling is already reviewed, while PR2979 lists integral packing at its cap as open question 3: its T74 basis is fractional (denominators 4 and 20) and its fill is 1.782e-9 below the cap. This is a bounded, explicitly packing-only change of the newest candidate, reported against its exact cap (attained) and the trusted ceiling() of its local profile (98.45% realized).
bottleneck_link: Packing only: the paid local profile is unchanged, so the gain is capped by PR2979's fixed-capacity relaxation; this attains that cap exactly (+1.782229002663727e-9 over PR2979's headline). It closes the packing layer for these words, so further gains must change the words (PR2979 open questions 1 and 2).
stop_rule: Publish only if PR2979's vendored owner engine accepts the literal T740 allocation with the claimed complete profile, the idle histogram is exactly 740 x the optimal basic idle profile (root = certified cap), and the re-pinned moment auditor shows a strict gain over PR2979's headline; otherwise stop.
evidence: verify.py (stdlib, about 65 s): live PR2979 input pins; providers re-derived from PR2979's words; T740 rebuilt by lift.py with pinned canonical payload SHA-256; owner engine over 2,717,280 roles (windows, same-call families, capacities, masks, compact prefixes, complete profile, rank mass); physical 663,549; cap certificate re-verified; exact fixed counts on the optimal face (93/4, 1341/20, 7619/20 per replica: 20 | T needed); idle = 740 x basic optimum; all bin patterns tight; root bracket = cap bracket; moment auditor re-pinned to PR2979 (strict gain). controls.py (stdlib, about 4 min): seven controls (no relocations keeps PR2979's root; dropped chain link, window violation, family collision, stale profile rejected by the engine; tampered relocations fail the payload pin; wrong moment baseline rejected). reproduce.py: PR2979's complete replay with this T740 allocation (status in the PR).
author: Rohan Arun
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance (Anthropic Claude) for the analysis, search, implementation and checks; no independent human review is claimed.

open_questions.question: Can a T smaller than 740 (necessarily a multiple of 20) attain the same cap with a chronology accepted by the outer contract?
open_questions.why_it_matters: T740 makes the literal allocation ten times larger than T74; a T20/T40/T60 chronology would make the admission cheaper.
open_questions.first_step: Construct a non-PR2917 call order at T20 or T40 and compute its windows with the vendored engine before any fill.
open_questions.blocked_by: PR2917's T37-based order and the admission/outer chain assume that chronology; a new order needs its own window and admission work, and gives no kappa beyond the cap.
